t: You're at the site of Little Holland House, which no longer stands. It was the dower house of Holland House, at the end of Nightingale Lane, now the back entrance to Holland Park. It was demolished when Melbury Road was laid out, and number 14 Melbury Road marks roughly where it stood. Julia Stephen lived here. She was a philanthropist and Pre-Raphaelite model, wife of the biographer Leslie Stephen, and mother of Virginia Woolf and Vanessa Bell, both of the Bloomsbury Group.
